'''Marc Baldus''' is a physicist and professor of NMR spectroscopy at [[Utrecht University]]. He is especially known for his work in the field of [[structural biology]] using [[solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance]] (ssNMR) spectroscopy. He applies ssNMR methods to establish structure-function relationships in complex biomolecular systems including membrane and Amyloid proteins.  In addition, he develops cellular NMR methods to study large molecular transport and insertion systems in bacteria as well as signal transduction mechanisms in [[Eukaryote|eukaryotic]] cells.

== Biography ==
Marc Baldus studied [[physics]] at the [[Technische Universität Darmstadt]], after which he became a Diploma Student at the Department of Physics of [[University of Florida]] in Gainesville, USA. He obtained his PhD degree in 1996 from the [[ETH Zurich]] in Switzerland. After postdoctoral research at [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology|MIT]] and [[Leiden University]] he became group leader at the [[Max Planck Institute for Biophysical Chemistry]] in Goettingen, Germany. In 2008 he became Full Professor of Structural Biology in the [[Bijvoet Centre for Biomolecular Research]] at [[Utrecht University]] in Utrecht.<ref name="UU profile page">{{cite web|title=prof. dr. M. (Marc) Baldus|url=http://www.uu.nl/medewerkers/MBaldus|publisher=[[Utrecht University]]|accessdate=2015-11-04}}</ref> From 2016 to 2019 he was scientific director of the Bijvoet Centre for Biomolecular Research.<ref>{{cite web|title=Marc Baldus new scientific director of the Bijvoet Center|url=http://www.uu.nl/en/news/marc-baldus-new-scientific-director-of-the-bijvoet-center|publisher=[[Utrecht University]]|date=6 April 2016|accessdate=2016-04-06}}</ref>

== Research ==
Marc Baldus is an expert in the field of structural biology using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (ssNMR) spectroscopy. In addition, he develops cellular NMR methods for structural biology, such as [[dynamic nuclear polarization|Dynamic Nuclear Polarization]] (DNP) NMR spectroscopy and his research group at Utrecht University was the first group worldwide with a 527&nbsp;GHz Solid State DNP-NMR spectrometer.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.genengnews.com/gen-news-highlights/university-of-utrecht-orders-bruker-s-527-ghz-dnp-nmr-system-to-study-membrane-proteins/81244373/|title=University of Utrecht Orders Bruker's 527 GHz DNP-NMR System to Study Membrane Proteins|date=13 December 2010|publisher=Genetic Engineering & Biotechnology News|accessdate=2016-03-18}}</ref><ref>{{cite The main focus of the research of Marc Baldus is the use of solid state NMR spectroscopy <ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/Publishing/ChemTech/Volume/2009/04/identifying_powders.asp|title=Crystal clear method for identifying powders|date=26 February 2009|accessdate=2016-03-18|author=Philip Robinson|publisher=[[Royal Society of Chemistry]]}}</ref> to study the structure and dynamics of proteins and other biomolecules.<ref name="UU profile page"/> He has used the technology amongst others to study the behavior of bacterial proteins,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.scinexx.de/wissen-aktuell-9364-2009-01-13.html|title=Wie Bakterien die Umwelt wahrnehmen
|language=DE|publisher=scinexx.de|date=13 January 2009|accessdate=2016-03-18}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.redorbit.com/news/health/1878686/how_bacteria_make_syringes/|title=How Bacteria Make Syringes|publisher=redOrbit|date=14 June 2010|author=Sam Savage|accessdate=2016-03-18}}</ref> protein aggregation in Alzheimer's<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1021/ja7100517|pmid=18386894|title=Characterization of Alzheimer's-like Paired Helical Filaments from the Core Domain of Tau Protein Using Solid-State NMR Spectroscopy|journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society|volume=130|issue=18|pages=5922–8|year=2008|last1=Andronesi|first1=Ovidiu C.|last2=Bergen|first2=Martin von|last3=Biernat|first3=Jacek|last4=Seidel|first4=Karsten|last5=Griesinger|first5=Christian|last6=Mandelkow|first6=Eckhard|last7=Baldus|first7=Marc|bibcode=2008JAChS.130.5922A }}</ref> and Parkinson's<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1073/pnas.0506109102 |title=Molecular-level secondary structure, polymorphism, and dynamics of full-length -synuclein fibrils studied by solid-state NMR |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences |volume=102 |issue=44 |pages=15871–6 |year=2005 |last1=Heise |first1=H. |last2=Hoyer |first2=W. |last3=Becker |first3=S. |last4=Andronesi |first4=O. == Honours and awards==
Marc Baldus received the Founders Medal of the International Conference on Magnetic Resonance in Biological Systems (ICMRBS) in August 2006.<ref>{{cite web|publisher=[[Chemical & Engineering News]]|title=Marc Baldus Receives Founders Medal|date=25 September 2006|url=http://cen.acs.org/articles/84/i39/Marc-Baldus-Receives-Founders-Medal.html?type=paidArticleContent|accessdate=2014-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|publisher=Max-Planck-Institut für biophysikalische Chemie|date=26 July 2006|language=DE|title=Auszeichnung für Marc Baldus vom MPI für biophysikalische Chemie|url=http://www3.mpibpc.mpg.de/groups/pr/PR/2006/06_13/|accessdate=2014-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|title=M. Baldus erhalt Founders-Medaille|date=December 2006|language=DE|publisher=Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker|journal=Mitteilungsblatt der Fachgruppe Magnetische Resonanzspektroskopie|url=https://www.gdch.de/fileadmin/downloads/Netzwerk_und_Strukturen/Fachgruppen/Magnetresonanz/MARS/mars132006-complete.pdf|accessdate=2014-11-04}}</ref> In 2014, Marc Baldus received the [[Günther Laukien#G.C3.BCnther-Laukien Prize|Günther Laukien Prize]] from [[Richard R. Ernst|Richard Ernst]], 1991 Nobel laureate in Chemistry. The prize recognizes cutting-edge experimental NMR research, is awarded yearly  and is one of the most prestigious prizes in the field of NMR and MRI.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.structuralbiology.eu/support/whats-on/news/marc-baldus-receives-prestigious-laukien-prize-2014|publisher=Instruct|date=25 March 2014|accessdate=2015-11-04|title=Marc Baldus receives prestigious Laukien Prize 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ti-coast.com/index.php?form=nieuws&id=196|date=25 March 2014|accessdate=2015-11-04|title=Marc Baldus receives prestigious Laukien Prize 2014|publisher=COAST}}{{dead link|date=January 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
